title: Payment Terminal Incident Response
description: Payment terminal incidents affecting hotel revenue operations
immediate_actions: Assess impact on hotel revenue operations and guest services
Implement manual payment procedures if needed
Contact hotel management for operational impact assessment
investigation_steps: Review payment terminal logs and status
Check payment gateway connectivity and performance
Verify network connectivity to payment terminals
resolution_steps: Restart payment terminal services following standard procedures
Implement payment gateway fixes if needed
Apply payment system patches or configuration changes
Coordinate with payment processor for complex issues
verification: Test payment terminal functionality at affected properties
Confirm with hotel staff that system is operational
special_considerations: Payment terminal incidents must be coordinated with hotel finance
Payment processing is critical for hotel revenue operations
Manual procedures may impact guest experience
Maintain PCI compliance during system restoration
